'''Alexei Nikolaievich Skorobogatov''' ({{langx|ru|Алексе́й Никола́евич Скоробога́тов}}) is a [[Russians in the United Kingdom|British-Russian]] [[mathematician]] and Professor in Pure Mathematics at [[Imperial College London]] specialising in [[algebraic geometry]]. His work has focused on [[rational point]]s, the [[Hasse principle]], the [[Manin obstruction]], [[exponential sum]]s, and [[error-correcting code]]s.

==Education==
He completed his [[dissertation]] under the supervision of [[Yuri Manin]], for which he was awarded a [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] degree.<ref>{{MathGenealogy |id=62879 }}</ref>

==Awards==
In 2001 he was awarded a [[Whitehead Prize]] by the [[London Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.lms.ac.uk/activities/prizes_com/citations01/skorobogatov.html |title=Citation for Alexei Nikolaievich Skorobogatov |access-date=2010-01-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051026083058/http://www.lms.ac.uk/activities/prizes_com/citations01/skorobogatov.html |archive-date=2005-10-26 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He was elected as a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in the 2020 Class, for "contributions to the Diophantine geometry of surfaces and higher dimensional varieties".<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.ams.org/profession/ams-fellows/new-fellows|title=2020 Class of the Fellows of the AMS|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|accessdate=2019-11-03}}</ref>
